subject: Temporary eval top-up while PO completes security review
messages:
From: Maya Shah <maya.shah@novaplus.co>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0500
Subject: Request — short credits while PO is in legal review

Hi Sean,

Quick one from procurement: our internal PO for the Redwood Dedicated evaluation has routed to legal for the data protection addendum and is expected to clear in roughly 7–10 business days. The engineering team is mid-eval and would lose a lot of momentum if we drop access.

Is there a way Redwood can top up our sandbox with a small amount of temporary credits (we estimate ~$500) or extend the trial window while the PO/DPAs finish? We can share the requisition and the expected PO number once legal confirms.

I appreciate any flexibility — we remain very interested in proceeding fast once the contract is finalized.

Attachments: novaplus_purchase_requisition.pdf (PDF, 215KB)

Thanks,
Maya Shah
Head of Partnerships | NovaPlus Health
maya.shah@novaplus.co
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Shah <maya.shah@novaplus.co>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 10:08:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request — short credits while PO is in legal review

Hi Maya — thanks for the note and for sending the requisition. Totally understand the momentum risk.

We can provision an interim sandbox credit to keep your engineers running while legal finalizes the PO/DPA. Typical approach: we issue a one-time $500 credit and a 14-day access extension; when the PO processes we reconcile against the committed purchase.

Before I schedule the credit, two quick asks:
- Can procurement confirm the expected PO date or PO number once available?
- Can you confirm the environment name (project ID) that should receive the credit?

Cc'ing Priyom (billing ops) and Laura (your AM) to approve the temporary credit and flag any constraints from finance. If we need an approval ticket I can open one.

If that's acceptable I’ll apply the credit by end of day today (EST) and follow up with a short confirmation email + credit-authorization stub.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0123
